panels.description: On-chain voting liveness for every observed watched validator. ACTIVE means Solana reports the vote account in the current set. DELINQUENT means it is not keeping up with cluster voting. This does not probe the validator's private RPC process.

targets.expr: max by (identity) (sol_watched_validator_info{network=~"$network",status="current"}) or (max by (identity) (sol_watched_validator_info{network=~"$network",status="delinquent"}) * 0)

targets.expr: clamp_max((max((100 * sol_watched_validator_blocks_missed{network=~"$network"} / clamp_min(sol_watched_validator_blocks_missed{network=~"$network"} + sol_watched_validator_blocks_produced{network=~"$network"}, 1)) > bool 5) or vector(0)) + (max((100 * sol_watched_validator_blocks_missed{network=~"$network"} / clamp_min(sol_watched_validator_blocks_missed{network=~"$network"} + sol_watched_validator_blocks_produced{network=~"$network"}, 1)) > bool 10) or vector(0)), 2)
